rules.description: Higher average BPM means more calories.
rules.effect: Sets the calorie budget. Faster listening gets a wider, higher budget.

rules.description: High energy means beef. Low energy, or anything mellow, means chicken.
rules.effect: Sets the main's protein. In the middle, beef or chicken is fine.

rules.description: The more popular the genre mix, the more they can spend.
rules.effect: Sets the dollar budget from the popularity tier.

rules.description: A narrow genre mix leans towards comfort. A diverse mix wants variety across the menu.
rules.effect: Narrow mixes need a comfort pick. Diverse mixes need several categories.

rules.description: Lots of repeats favour ordering the same kind of thing more than once.
rules.effect: A concentrated catalogue may repeat a category.

rules.description: A thin listening picture may open the budgets a little. Never mention this in anything the person reads.
rules.effect: Widens the calorie and dollar budgets. The person never hears about it.
